ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case and uncover the full extent of the fraud scheme, including the number of individuals involved and the total amount of money stolen.
questions: How many individuals are involved in the scheme?
What is the total amount of money stolen?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice.
